notes.title: New Update v17!
notes.notes:
Heyo, my friends!!

Today, we just fixed a few small bugs regarding getting out of the ship and entering a whirlpool and being trapped without moving (on both the new Christmas Event map and also the Raid Boss map).

Thank you to Kayla❤ for submitting this bug. 

We have also adjusted the "Credits" page to let you know there is now a category for streamers on both Twitch and Kick!!

notes.title: DHOFv16 Christmas Event!
notes.notes:
Update v16: Deep Horrors of Fishing

🎄 Holiday Cheer Awaits! 🎄

Happy Holidays, Anglers! We're thrilled to announce the release of our latest update, packed with festive fun and exciting new items to enhance your fishr adventures.

What's New in v16:
🎅 Christmas Event
Dive into the holiday spirit with our limited-time Christmas Event! Collect exclusive holiday-themed items and uncover the mysteries of the season beneath the waves.

🐟 New Fish to Catch
Three new fish species have been added to the roster, each more elusive and rewarding than the last. Can you reel them all in?

🌍 New Map
Yeah, you heard that right! There is a new map. HOW TO GET TO IT?  I would check out some WATERFALL area.

🎣 New Gear
Fishing Rod: Equip the latest high-performance fishing rod to tackle even the toughest catches.
Ring: Discover a powerful new ring that boosts your ATK and DEF.
Collectible Items: Hunt for newly added collectibles to expand your collection and unlock rewards.

We hope you enjoy the new content and have a fantastic time fishing this holiday season. Thank you for being part of our incredible community!!

🎁 Happy Holidays! 🎁


-NecroCatic Games-

notes.title: DHOF v15
notes.notes:
Hey, friends! We have another update for DEEP HORRORS OF FISHING! We are back with the 15th version and made the following adjustments!!

-Added a fish (the ELUSIVE FISH #16) to the fishing roster. This one is now located on Map 9 (Ocean 2). Great catch on StormerSage's part and thank you for noticing that it wasn't spawning!! HUGE PROPS TO THEM AND THEIR FEEDBACK!

-Adjusted EVERY Fish in the FISHING BOOK to tell you which map it's found on. Also u/StormerSage's recommendation!

-We also added a Pink Fashion Item to the FASHION SHOP. Hope you enjoy fishing in FASHION!!!

Thank you for the support, my friends - YOU ARE LEGENDS!! 

In addition, I was pleasantly surprised to see we have surpassed 100 wishlists for the game!!! THANK YOU FOR THIS!!

Until Next Time,

-NecroCaticGames-

notes.title: v12 "The Frozen Depths"
notes.notes:
"As winter's grip tightens, the frozen seas awaken. Venture into the icy abyss, where the frost hides ancient horrors and unimaginable treasures. notes.title: Deep Horrors of Fishing v11
notes.notes:
We have RELEASED the 11th version of "DEEP HORRORS OF FISHING"!

I want to thank all of you for the overwhelming support and want to personally thank Xinitii for not only the FIRST review but for the amazing amount of feedback regarding the game! You didn't have to but you did... So now we updated the game today and tweaked it to add the following: 

-Tweaked all 14 fishes on the map before the last boss!! These stats were not correct!

-Lowered the cost of the Ultimate Master Fishing Rod to 10,000 (instead of 25k)!! WOW!

-Added a FASHION STORE that you can pick up a BLUE FASHION EQUIPPABLE (It costs 5k)! Also, we put a "Back to Normal" fashion item that returns your looks to normal. It does not CONSUME (reusable). We hope you enjoy this BONUS Fashion Item. 

Hopefully these changes to the game bring you more enjoyable and is less GRINDY.

HAPPY FISHING, my friends!! I GENUINELY want to thank you for playing the game and for supporting us. YOU ALL ARE LEGENDS! Have a great one!


-NecroCaticGames-

notes.title: v4 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello there!!

Way to turn down music and sound fx by 5 in options.

Options to change the color of window (in options).

Thank you for playing,
